title: 245TB Micron 6600 ION Data Center SSD Now Shipping
summary: Micron has launched the 6600 ION data center SSD featuring industry-leading 245TB capacity, designed for hyperscale data centers requiring high-density storage with consistent performance and low power consumption.
problem_solved: Addresses the growing storage density demands of hyperscale data centers that need more capacity per server rack while maintaining power efficiency.
why_valuable: The 245TB capacity sets a new industry benchmark for single SSD form factor, enabling data centers to reduce server count, floor space, and total cost of ownership.
